5303.title: Media attachments receive an unreadable-file instruction without transcription guidance
5303.rootCauseOneLine: The Claude attachment formatter unconditionally recommends Read, while the injected introduction and top-level guide omit the existing transcription command.
5303.proposedFix: Use MIME-aware transcription guidance in the Claude attachment formatter, and advertise the existing command in the bb-guide introduction and top-level guide. Preserve ordinary file and image guidance.
5303.caveats: The actual prompt handed to the SDK was tested using the existing SDK stub. No live model or transcription service was invoked, so subsequent agent choices and long-recording service behavior were not tested. No automatic fix was pushed because a complete repair crosses provider and guide subsystems, outside the one-subsystem simple-fix gate.
